answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on various conditional generation datasets... RocStories ... and Paradetox ... keyword-based story generation experiments confirm that our model effectively generates coherent and controlled text...
answer_1.outputs: conditional text sequences such as detoxified sentences, paraphrased questions, summaries, translations, and generated stories

answer_2.quote: We use Perplexity (PPL) based-on GPT-2 Large and GPT-2 XL as an automated metric, MAUVE ... to assess style consistency, SOME ... to score the grammar...

answer_3.quote: For Question Generation (QG), we employ the widely adopted GPT-as-a-Judge framework ... to evaluate the quality of generations produced by our model and the baselines...
criteria: being a more reasonable question to the input (condition) text

answer_4.quote: Mean Opinion Score (MOS) from human evaluations to gauge text quality... four integrated ph.d student annotators in the NLP research lab evaluate the generated text...
answer_4.guideline: annotators evaluate based on: (1) semantic reflectiveness of the condition, indicating how accurately the condition is represented in the text, and (2) sentence completeness, assessing overall grammatical and semantic coherence... for diversity MOS: (1) condition's semantic reflectiveness, and (2) sentence diversity, capturing both semantic and structural variety
